✦ Field guide & abilities
Mission

Grab green commits and golden commits, survive increasingly clever red bugs and keep your streak alive. Every 10 commits unlocks a Copilot tip.

Shield ⬡

Absorbs a red bug collision.

Magnet ◎

Pulls nearby commits toward Mona for 8 seconds.

Merge Dash ⚡

Short burst of invulnerability; recharges in 4 seconds.

Controls

Move with A/D or arrows; Space to dash. On mobile, drag Mona or hold left/right. Press P to pause.

Levels

Explore Contribution City, PR Highway and Merge Galaxy. New bugs appear gradually; bosses show up every 25 commits.
